entities.summary: Bad Säckingen is a rural town in the administrative district of Waldshut in the state of Baden-Württemberg in Germany. It is famous as the "Trumpeter's City" because of the book Der Trompeter von Säckingen, a famous 19th-century novel by German author Joseph Victor von Scheffel.
